meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审一遍已完成的改动，在交付前盯住目标、约束、代码质量与安全隐患
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚完成一批改动，准备交付却想先确认没有遗漏问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just finished changes and want a final check before handing off the PR

howto.what: 实现完成后，Claude 先自己在真实环境跑手动 QA，再启动一个（只一个，不是一组）gate reviewer 子代理，按目标、约束、代码质量、安全、遗漏上下文和 QA 证据审计全部改动。QA 无失败行且 reviewer 返回 APPROVE 才算通过。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接前，或用户明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发。

say.text: 对这次改动做 gate review
say.note: 先手动 QA，再派一个 reviewer

say.text: 在真实环境跑一遍 QA，再让 gate reviewer 审
say.note: QA 有失败行就直接判失败

say.text: 交接 PR 前帮我审一遍这次实现
say.note: 核对目标、约束与 QA 证据

howto.what_en: Claude runs manual QA itself on the real surface, then launches ONE gate reviewer (not a panel) to audit goal, constraints, quality, security and QA evidence. It passes only when QA has no failing row and the reviewer approves.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.
